end.summary:
Trisha practised recognising that families can differ in size and members, using examples of two families.
Trisha practised why household work can be shared among family members; this still needs checking next time.
Trisha repeatedly said children are too small to help and that only grown-ups do family care; this was not corrected after the last time it appeared.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised family differences with Trisha using examples of a smaller family and a larger family, and discussed sharing tasks such as packing food and cleaning. Trisha could describe that family members care for one another, but continued to say that children are too small to help; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to choose one safe task, such as putting away a plate or organising books, and talk about how everyone can share household work.
